description: Research tokenized real-world assets on Solana: issuer controls, supply, liquidity, premiums
name: io.github.metis-rwa/mcp

environmentVariables.description: Solana JSON-RPC endpoint. Public nodes throttle the heavier reads, so a dedicated endpoint is recommended.
environmentVariables.name: SOLANA_RPC_URL

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Metis research API. Defaults to https://metisagent.co.
environmentVariables.name: METIS_API_URL

environmentVariables.description: Path to a JSON file of extra assets to register alongside the built-in universe.
environmentVariables.name: METIS_ASSETS_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Directory for the local observation history. Set to "off" to keep history in memory only.
environmentVariables.name: METIS_MCP_STATE_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Network timeout per outbound request, in milliseconds. Defaults to 20000.
environmentVariables.name: METIS_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS

title: Metis RWA Research
